channel.title: The Albert Lea Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Albert Lea Tribune (albertleatribune.com)

item.title: Spring Renewal: Top 5 Things to Do in Albert Lea This Season
item.description: When the final traces of Minnesota winter begin to recede and the first buds appear on the oaks in Myre-Big Island State Park, the energy in Albert Lea shifts.

item.title: Legislature dives into fraud, immigration, eviction issues as short session gets moving
item.description: After an opening day of somber ceremony, the Minnesota Legislature saw a jolt of action Wednesday as lawmakers used 19 committee hearings to start tackling the workload, and hundreds of Minnesotans filling the Capitol to raise top concerns.

item.title: Man arrested for domestic assault and other reports
item.description: Police arrested Jonathan Ortiz Lazu, 42, for domestic assault at 9:11 p.m. Wednesday at 424 E. Seventh St.

item.title: 2 injured after semi, tow truck collide on I-35
item.description: Two people were injured Wednesday night after a semi collided with a tow truck stopped on the right shoulder of Interstate 35 pulling out a vehicle in Steele County.

item.title: Rosella Margery (Roberts) Simon
item.description: Rosella Margery (Roberts) Simon, formerly of Albert Lea, entered heaven on January 30, 2026 in Waseca, MN.

item.title: Annual History Center meatball supper fundraiser returns
item.description: The History Center of Freeborn County will host its annual meatball supper from 5 to 7 p.m. Feb. 27 at the Albert Lea Moose Lodge, 1623 W. Main St.

item.title: INKAS® Launches High-Security Locksmith Services in Toronto
item.description: INKAS has officially expanded its service offering with the launch of professional high-security locksmith services in Toronto.

item.title: Albert Lea district facing budget reductions over $2M with similar cuts likely in coming years
item.description: The Albert Lea school district is facing budget reductions of $2 million or more for each of the next three years based on updated enrollment numbers for this school year and projections for the coming years.

item.title: ‘It works perfect for us’: Fairmont resident to open salon in Albert Lea offering nail art, lashes
item.description: A nail artist recently rented a building in Albert Lea that had been sitting empty in order to open her own salon. Now, that dream is about to become a reality.

item.title: Janis Loy Stadheim
item.description: Janis Loy Stadheim, 88, of Byron, MN, died Sunday, February 8, 2026, at Elysian Senior Homes of Lake City.
